name: Dalliances with the devil
source:
You're dead. Deceased. Very much so. But alas, the pearly gates did not beckon you forth.

Instead you face an afterlife of eternal damnation in the depths of flaming pits and agonising loneliness.

But--lucky for you! Looks like you've managed to strike a deal and it only costs...your soul!

(Basically free money! Who needs a soul anyways!)

So take your pick and select any of Hell's finest inhabitants to be your everlasting companion!

Although, maybe beware the pointy teeth.

Oh--and no refunds!

[From [url=https://mishatventures.itch.io/dalliances-with-the-devil]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你死定了。死者。非常如此。但可惜的是，珍珠之门并没有召唤你前去。

相反，你将在火坑深处面临永恒的诅咒和令人痛苦的孤独。

但是——你很幸运！看起来你已经成功达成了一项协议，而代价只是……你的灵魂！

（基本上是免费的钱！反正谁需要灵魂！）因此，请选择地狱中最优秀的居民作为你永远的伴侣！

不过，也许要小心尖牙。

哦——而且不退款！

[来自[url=https://mishatventures.itch.io/dalliances-with-the-devil]Itch.io[/url]]
